newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stocks follow Wall St up at open.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks follow Wall St up at open.

text.p: Australian shares followed Wall Street higher at the open on Friday with solid support for the leaders ensuring Thursday's rally was extended.
From the opening, the All Ordinaries index climbed 10.5 points to 2,373.0.
With solid turnover early, brokers said investors took heart from a buoyant Wall Street and took a sanguine view of weakness in metals prices in offshore markets.
"It's off to a good start after Wall Street's rise," said a Sydney broker.
"Metals are still reasonably firm and News has steadied, which has helped."
Whether this early strength would hold was a vexed question -- some players were unconvinced about the market's momentum.
"It's up now but will it hold? I don't know if it can go on with it," the broker said.
Rises outnumbered falls by a ratio of about two to one, while about 46 percent of stocks traded remained steady.
